_comment:
'When this enters the arena, up to 1 target attack gets +1{p}. / Ward 1' - Lightning Illusionist Instant - Aura.

WARD 1 NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - re-authoring it would be a defect.

ENTRY TRIGGER: TRIGGERED ON_ENTER_PLAY, dispatched from Zone.add on real arena entry (state.py ~304-310), which covers BOTH release-note-1 paths - resolving on the stack when played AND being put into the arena (or returned to it) by another card's effect.

TARGETING: the ability-level target.filter compiles to target_filter and is checked at resolution before anything runs (interpreter.py:42-45) - it is the gate that asks whether a legal attack exists right now. ATTACK_TYPE_IN reads 'types' and checks the CURRENT combat.attack_card's types+subtypes (condition_types.py:273-294), so ['Action'] matches every attack action card; ATTACK_IS_WEAPON (condition_types.py:198-199) covers weapon attacks via combat.from_weapon; the OR is 'any attack'. Played outside combat there is no attack_card, the filter fails, and nothing happens - which is release note 2's zero-target case ('if you do not [target any attacks], the triggered effect is not added to the stack'), behaviourally identical because zero targets is then the only legal choice anyway.

'UP TO 1' DECLINE: the triage pass flagged that zero-or-one targeting has no dedicated flag and blessed a MAY wrapper as the fallback - so when an attack DOES exist, MAY (effect_types.py:3788-3856) offers the pump and declining targets nothing, matching the printed 'up to'.

PUMP: MODIFY_ATTACK add 1 takes mod/amount (effect_types.py:4123-4158); on a non-recalc event it appends to combat.power_mods AND bumps live power, so the +1 survives later recalculation mid-chain and is not double-counted.
